title: MemeArena: Automating Context-Aware Unbiased Evaluation of Harmfulness Understanding for Multimodal Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating 'harmfulness' and 'safety' in multimodal memes, specifically targeting social media toxicity, misinformation, and racial/political stereotypes.
